Cc: procurement@verahealth.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logs and BYOK gating for pilot

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Vera Health is excited to move the pilot forward, but our security team has a short checklist we need cleared before signing the contract. High-level asks below — please let me know what is feasible as a firm gate versus what could be an exception for a limited pilot.

1) Audit log granularity: We need per-tenant, per-request audit records with user identity, model id & version, token counts, and a request/response hash. Retention: 12 months, searchable by customer id.
2) Data retention controls: Ability to set retention at tenant level and export snapshots on demand.
3) BYOK/KMS: Customer-managed keys with rotation support + an escrow option for emergency recovery.
4) SSO: SAML 2.0 integration + SCIM for provisioning. Need proof-of-concept timeline.
5) Evidence for SOC-like review: sample logs, architectural diagram, and if possible a signed attestation for the pilot.

Attached is our audit questionnaire (filled with initial notes). Can you send a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and timing?

Thanks,
Zack Morris
Security Lead, Vera Health
security@verahealth.com

Attachment: vera_audit_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 92KB)

Forwarding Vera's questionnaire — high priority pilot ask. Quick triage proposal below; can each of you flag ownership and any immediate blockers? I want to go into the kickoff call tomorrow with a clear internal MAP.

Key constraints:
- Vera requires per-tenant retention + export (this is product/infra change).
- BYOK escrow and rotation touches KMS policy + legal (encryption escrow is sensitive).
- Audit log searchability for 12 months may require retention-tier adjustments + cost estimate.

My suggested short-term approach (for pilot):
- Audit logs: provide per-tenant exports daily (S3 export) + searchable subset (index last 90 days). Owner: Grace.
- Retention controls: product to scope tenant-level flag and admin API; interim: manual retention policy per-account. Owner: Priyom.
- BYOK: offer customer-managed key integration (AES envelope keys + KMS) but defer escrow design; offer signed attestation as interim. Owner: Jonas.
- SSO: schedule SAML + SCIM POC; Ben to lead.

Attachments to send Vera with the MAP draft: redwood_proposed_map_v1.md (draft with owners/timelines).

Please reply with: 1) accept/modify owners, 2) any unworkable items, and 3) rough ETA (weeks) for a minimal pilot gating set.

—
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Fwd: Vera Health — audit logs, BYOK & SSO gating

Thanks for the ping — quick technical triage below after scanning Vera's questionnaire. I bolded items that will require infra work.

Audit logs
- What we have: request metadata (timestamp, client_id, model_id, token_count) in our telemetry, but not stored as a per-tenant audit object with request/response hashes.
- Proposal (pilot): daily S3 export of request-level records per tenant + a lightweight indexing service to support simple queries for the last 90 days.
- Infra effort: ~3 weeks (1 engineer) to add tenant-scoped export pipeline + permissions. Full 12-month searchable retention is a separate project (cost + storage).

Retention controls
- Product change: tenant-level retention flag + admin API (backend + UI).
- Interim workaround: manual retention assignment + export snapshots on request.
- Effort: product + infra, ~4 weeks for API + 2 weeks for UI polish. Can scope MVP to API only for pilot.

BYOK/KMS
- We support customer KMS integration today for some partners, but rotation + escrow policy is not implemented.
- Short-term: accept BYOK for tenant, document rotation cadence requirements, provide emergency key-rotation playbook (manual).
- Escrow: requires legal + security review; timeline ~6–8 weeks to design + validate.

SSO (SAML + SCIM)
- Ben to confirm, but we have a SAML integration template; SCIM provisioning will need work for user sync.
- POC estimate: 2 weeks.

Deliverables to offer Vera this week:
- Draft MAP (Tessa) with owners/timelines (send by EOD)
- Sample anonymized logs (90-day window) and architecture diagram (Grace)
- Temporary attestation letter for pilot (Legal/Security)

Risks/notes:
- Full 12-month searchable audit retention will materially increase unit cost — we should include a cost estimate in the MAP and propose alternative queries (hash-based retrieval on demand).
- BYOK escrow will likely require contract amendment — loop Legal early.

I can have the export + sample dataset for Vera by Wed if we prioritize infra.

Grace O'Connor
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Zack — thanks for the clear asks and the filled questionnaire. We reviewed this internally and propose the following pilot gating plan so Vera can start in a constrained but safe configuration while we work toward the full asks.

Pilot gating (short-term commitments)
- Audit logs: We will provide daily per-tenant exports of request metadata and a searchable index for the last 90 days. We can produce sample logs and an architecture diagram by Wed, Apr 21.
- Retention: Tenant-level retention flag API (MVP) to be delivered in ~3–4 weeks; in the interim we will run manual retention controls and provide on-demand exports.
- BYOK: We can integrate your KMS for the pilot and document rotation process; escrow design requires additional review — we'll provide a signed attestation for the pilot window.
- SSO: We'll schedule a SAML + SCIM POC; proposed dates below.

Next steps (actions and owners)
- Tessa: send MAP draft and schedule kickoff (link -> HubSpot record).
- Grace: produce sample anonymized logs + architecture diagram (ETA Wed 21 Apr).
- Ben: SSO POC scheduling and checklist.
- Priyom: scope retention-API work and provide ETA.
- Jonas: own BYOK requirements capture + legal intro for escrow discussion.

Meeting options for POC kickoff (please pick one):
- Tue Apr 20, 2pm PT
- Wed Apr 21, 11am PT

We attached a draft MAP that lists these items and provisional timelines. If that looks reasonable I'll raise a short exceptions doc for the pilot to get procurement moving while engineering executes the MVP items.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
